pairs.difference: A's whistle has a deeper, fatter barrel, a wider mouth slab and an oversized, thick steel ring that stands well clear of the lug. B has a slimmer mouthpiece tapering into the round chamber, a tighter step under the barrel and a thinner ring tucked behind the lug. Both keep flat side faces and fairly tight bevels, so the gap is small.
pairs.fix: Slim the whistle's mouthpiece and barrel to true proportions, keep the top and side faces flat with tight bevels, and make the steel ring thin and small, close against the lug.

pairs.difference: B's bugle has a very large bell, a short body and a loop tube as thick as a sausage, with two huge puffy tassels and thick cords. A has a slim tapering tube, a narrow double loop, a thin mouthpiece stem, a fine rope wrap and small tassels on thin cords.
pairs.fix: Draw a slim brass bugle with a long, thin tube of even width and a narrow double loop. Use a modest bell, thin cords and two small, fine tassels with narrow strands.

pairs.difference: A's cup is swollen and tall, with a thick tube-like blue rim, a fat sausage handle, a chunky foot and a saucer with a puffy edge. B has a tapered cup, a thin rim, a slimmer handle with a clean opening, a low foot ring and a thin flat saucer with a crisp lip.
pairs.fix: Draw a thin-walled porcelain teacup with a tapered bowl and a fine rim. Add a slim handle, a low foot ring and a shallow, thin saucer with a crisp edge.

pairs.difference: B's basket has a fat, knobbly rope handle, thick collar wraps where it meets the rim, a rim lumped into rolls and a tall, deep body. Its apples are smaller, with oversized leaves that break the contour. A has a slimmer tapering handle, a shallower, wider basket and big apples that read at true scale, with only a thin stem breaking the outline.
pairs.fix: Make the basket shallower and wider, with a thinner twisted handle joined by a small binding and a slimmer rim. Draw larger apples with thin stems and no big leaves.

pairs.difference: A's barrel has four thick, heavy hoops that step out from the contour, big rivets, oversized chunky stave ends around the open top and a strong bulge. B has thin hoops close to the wood, a gentle belly, flat narrow stave lines and a clean, even top edge.
pairs.fix: Draw a barrel with a gentle belly and thin metal hoops sitting flush on the staves. Remove the big rivets and keep the stave ends slim and level at the top rim.

pairs.difference: B's taxi is squashed short, with a tall cabin, an oversized roof sign, big fat tyres, sausage-like bumper bars and bulging wings, so it reads as a toy. A keeps a longer, lower sedan body with a true bonnet length, a thin bumper, smaller wheels and a small roof sign.
pairs.fix: Draw a sedan with a long, low body and a real bonnet length. Use normal-sized wheels, a thin straight chrome bumper and a small, low roof sign.

pairs.difference: B's tent has thick crossed poles at the peak, a fat rope binding, sausage guy ropes and stubby oversized log pegs, with toggle patches and a lantern and rock added at the foot. A has one simple canvas form with long sloping planes, thin guy lines and tiny pegs.
pairs.fix: Draw a simple canvas tent with long flat sloping sides, thin guy lines and tiny pegs. Leave out the thick poles, chunky ropes and added props.

pairs.difference: B has fat barrel-like log posts splayed at an angle, thick rope lashings, a big ring and a ballooned round pot sitting on a heap of bulbous stones, and all these parts merge into one lump in the silhouette. A has straight, slim upright posts with a clean crossbar, a thin wire bail handle, an open-rim pot of true shape and a small fire clearly below it.
pairs.fix: Draw two straight, slim posts with a thin crossbar and a thin wire handle. Use a wide, shallow pot with a clean rim, a small fire below it with clear space between them, and no heap of stones or added props.

pattern: Generated cards still fatten thin parts: tubes, handles, ropes, cords, bumpers and hoops all come out as uniform sausages. Objects are shortened and enlarged into toys, with oversized accents such as tassels, roof signs, wheels and rivets. Faces swell into pillows, and silhouettes grow lumpy from added props and chunky fittings, where real cards keep slim parts, flat planes and a simple, true outline.
